cohort.replicate_note: 20 chromosomes are associated measurements within one cell; every bootstrap interval describes intra-cell technical/structural variation, never biological replication.

denominators.na_rule: An undefined chromosome or undefined statistic is reported as NA and is never replaced by 0.5; the primary 20-chromosome macro value is None when any chromosome is undefined, and a separate defined-only value with its n is always reported next to it.

isolation.evaluation_side_order: every candidate / control / null coordinate file is written and hashed into a pre-reference gate before the evaluator process arms the gate and parses phase labels or the reference 3DG
isolation.selection_rule: candidate selection uses only the label-free count objective; reference, R1, R2, R3 never select a start, a parameter, a stopping point or a candidate
isolation.frozen_third_party: native/hickit and docs/RECONSTRUCTION_V1_PROTOCOL.md bytes are unchanged; 045/046/049 source trees are read-only inputs

p0.status_purpose: pure evaluation, zero fitting: R1 (two ceilings) and R3 for five already-frozen endpoints
p0.r1_scope: intra-chromosomal, same-copy fully-labelled, non-diagonal, OFF=3 Mb metric-grid records only; inter records never enter label accuracy
p0.r1_primary_statistic: 20-chromosome macro mean (all20, None if any chromosome is undefined) plus defined-only mean and pooled-over-common-records value

endpoints.role: 046 base endpoint selected by its own count NLL
registered work control (post-hoc adopted baseline, 1988 FG including multiresolution stages)
049 endpoint pre-selected by its own loss-A count before any reference read
049 endpoint pre-selected by its own loss-B count before any reference read
049 endpoint pre-selected by its own loss-C count before any reference read

oracle.provenance: pr/s0.py:oracle_keep(a1,a2)=(a1>=0)&(a2>=0) over all 496021 records whose BOTH ends carry a phase label; no incompletely labelled oracle
oracle.cost: reused as-is, not refitted in this round

p1.kind: local optimization diagnostic with a shared-start fork; NOT an independent blind reconstruction and NOT a biological replicate
p1.target: loss A = marginal_G (045 original G), full-J objective

optimizer.solver: scipy L-BFGS-B via the frozen m1_preconditioner.run_budgeted_lbfgs
optimizer.fg_cap_semantics: exact value+analytic-gradient call cap; the endpoint is the last callback-confirmed accepted state
optimizer.history_reset: both arms start a fresh L-BFGS history at their base point
optimizer.stopping_space: canonical raw_y/q gradient (for ms: P^-1 of the optimizer-space z gradient)

p1.start_carry_rule: coordinates, raw_y, p and q are carried out of the frozen 046 NPZ elementwise exactly; the raw and ms arms of the same base therefore share bit-identical start coordinates / raw_y / q. p is checked against p_from_q(q) bit-exactly.

ms_preconditioner.L: per-chromosome 1 Mb path-graph Neumann Laplacian over all bins of that chromosome
ms_preconditioner.eigenbasis: scipy.fft DCT-II norm=ortho; lambda_k = 4 sin^2(pi k / (2n))
ms_preconditioner.parameterization: optimizer variable z = P^-1 raw_y, q unchanged
ms_preconditioner.dependency: torch CUDA backend reused from 045/049; no new solver, no new dependency

exposure_and_sphere.exposure: fixed production e from the frozen 045 aggregate (V0-fixed-production-e mode)
exposure_and_sphere.sphere: frozen contact_model sphere mapping, unit ball strictly enforced

p1.gradient_label_correction: the frozen 045 stage_fit labels the ms iter0 canonical gradient and endpoint.raw_y_q_gradient_inf with the optimizer-space z gradient; the 049 round repaired this after writing. In round 050 the same documented repair is applied and the raw_y/q gradient is the only gradient used for stopping and reporting (raw and repaired values are both kept).
p1.expected_value_reference: The 049 gate1 parity value 9.542018998907452 belongs to the 046 real-extension-G-full-J point only. It is NOT the expected value of either 046 base start; each base start is measured on its own in p1/gates/.
p1.comparison_rule: all four arms are reported; nothing is re-selected after evaluation

p1_evaluation.r2: Pearson and Spearman matched / cross / contrast / minmargin on the frozen old21 mask, whole-chromosome single A/B swap per chromosome, identical geometry matching for both members of every pair
p1_evaluation.r1_r3: same independent evaluator family as P0, run after the P0 adapter regression passed

bootstrap.unit: 20 paired chromosomes; fixed denominator; undefined chromosome is reported and never removed silently

nulls.u0: u = 0 control (the two copies of every chromosome coincide)
nulls.random_u: 16 draws with seeds 450500..450515, same rule as the frozen 046 round
nulls.support_rule: each null reports its own resolvable support; the main candidate comparison common support is NOT intersected with null resolvability, so a tied/undefined u0 never empties the R3 mask

p1_evaluation.spatial_reads: 20 merged chromosome centres (190 distances) and 40 copy centres across chromosomes (760 distances); pooled inter must never be reported as chromosome placement

p2.purpose: label-free centre / rigid-block observability diagnostic on the 046 work baseline; fixes the gap that the 049 smooth_common_mode probe has zero per-chromosome mean and therefore never moved a chromosome centre

families.label: both copies of one chromosome translated together by a common per-chromosome vector
families.preserves: intra-chromosome geometry and the two-copy relative geometry

families.label: both copies of one chromosome rotated together about the common chromosome centre
families.preserves: intra-chromosome geometry and the two-copy relative geometry

p2.amplitude_definition: whole-cell displacement RMS, measured after global translational motion is removed; the rotation amplitude is defined by the same displacement-RMS rule so the two families are comparable
p2.direction_rule: directions are fixed in advance from a configured seed and are never chosen using the reference
p2.infeasible_rule: if the strict unit ball would be violated the whole amplitude is scaled down by one uniform factor and the actual RMS is reported; no per-bead clipping (which would break rigidity)
checks: global translation removed in probe coordinates
proper global rotation accounted for in the aligned RMS readout
all probe coordinates strictly inside the unit ball
p2.checks_note: Clarified after the P1 fits had started and before any P2 probe was executed. The frozen amplitude rule is the displacement RMS after removing the global mean displacement; the probe coordinates themselves are only made translation-free. A proper Kabsch alignment is applied separately for the aligned RMS deformation readout, which accounts for any residual global rotation without altering the probe coordinates. No P1 scientific field changed in this clarification.
p2.scope: 8 probes are the base design; no automatic sweep. A few directions can neither prove nor disprove global identifiability.
p2.no_fit: exposure e and p are fixed at the baseline values; nothing is fitted and the reference never guides the probes
